purpose: Development-only queries for calibrating the semantic evidence gate. They are written for calibration, are not the R8 acceptance inputs, and must not be replaced by them. Held-out evaluation remains TJ's separate suite.
corpus: fixtures/documents (the same 15 synthetic documents as R8)
calibrationRule: GATE_MIN_MARGIN is the midpoint between the largest unrelated-query margin and the smallest related-query margin when the two sets separate; otherwise the value that maximizes related passes minus unrelated passes, preferring the lower value on ties. GATE_MIN_TOP_COSINE is chosen the same way from top cosines. Both are recorded with the run that produced them.
